verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird documents a venture capital practice that advises high-growth companies on funding rounds, venture debt and exits. Its TwoVenture hub offers guidance to start-ups, including a 'Start & Seed' section. None of the evidence documents company incorporation work: no charter, bylaws, initial board consents or founder stock purchase services. Financing and life-cycle guidance is adjacent and does not show a formation practice.

support.subject: As a founder, I can engage the firm to incorporate my company — charter, bylaws, initial board consents, and founder stock purchase — documented as a core of its startup/emerging-companies practice
